'''''Annals of Probability''''' is a leading peer-reviewed probability [[Academic journal|journal]] published by the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]], which is the main international society for researchers in the areas of probability and statistics. The journal was started in 1973 as a continuation in part of the ''[[Annals of Mathematical Statistics]]'', which was split into the ''[[Annals of Statistics]]'' and this journal.

In July 2021,<ref>{{Cite web|title=Google Scholar Metrics overview|url=https://scholar.google.com/intl/en/scholar/metrics.html#overview|access-date=2021-11-08|website=scholar.google.com}}</ref> the journal was ranked 7th in the field Probability & Statistics with Applications according to [[Google Scholar]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Probability & Statistics with Applications – Google Scholar Metrics|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=top_venues&hl=en&vq=phy_probabilitystatistics|access-date=2021-10-29|website=scholar.google.com}}</ref> It had an [[impact factor]] of 1.470 ({{asof|2010|lc=y}}), according to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]''.<ref name=WoS>{{cite book |year=2012 |chapter=Annals of Probability |title=[[Journal Citation Reports|2010 Journal Citation Reports]] |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition=Science |series=[[Web of Science]] }}</ref> The impact factor for 2018 is 2.085. Its [[CiteScore]] is 4.3, and [[SCImago Journal Rank]] is 3.184, both from 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Scopus preview – Scopus – Annals of Probability|url=https://www.scopus.com/sourceid/24724|access-date=2021-10-29|website=scopus.com}}</ref>

==Editors-in-chief: past and present==
The following persons have been editor-in-chief of the journal:<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://www.readcube.com/articles/10.1002%2F0471667196.ess0045.pub2|title=Encyclopedia of Statistical Sciences|date=2006|isbn=978-0-471-66719-3|language=en|doi=10.1002/0471667196.ess0045.pub2}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} Past Editors of IMS Publications|url=https://imstat.org/past-editors-of-ims-journals/|access-date=2021-10-28|language=en}}</ref>
* Ronald Pyke (1972–1975)<ref>{{Cite journal|date=1973|title=Front Matter|url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/2959076|journal=The Annals of Probability|volume=1|issue=6|jstor=2959076 |issn=0091-1798}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Cramer|first=Harald|date=1976|title=Half a Century with Probability Theory: Some Personal Recollections|journal=The Annals of Probability|volume=4|issue=4|pages=509–546|doi=10.1214/aop/1176996025|issn=0091-1798|doi-access=free}}</ref>
* [[Patrick Billingsley]] (1976–1978)<ref>{{Cite web|title=Patrick Billingsley, probability theorist and actor, 1925–2011|url=https://news.uchicago.edu/story/patrick-billingsley-probability-theorist-and-actor-1925-2011|access-date=2021-10-28|website=news.uchicago.edu|language=en}}</ref>
* [[Richard Mansfield Dudley|Richard M. Dudley]] (1979–1981)<ref>{{Cite web|title=Richard M. Dudley {{!}} MIT Mathematics|url=https://math.mit.edu/about/history/obituaries/dudley.php|access-date=2021-10-28|website=math.mit.edu}}</ref>
* [[Thomas Milton Liggett|Thomas M. Liggett]] (1985–1987)<ref>{{Cite web|title=Thomas M. Liggett|url=https://www.math.ucla.edu/~tml/cv.html|access-date=2021-10-28|website=math.ucla.edu}}</ref>
* Peter E. Ney (1988–1990)
* Burgess Davis (1991–1993)<ref>{{Cite web|title=Burgess James Davis|url=https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx?src=https://www.stat.purdue.edu/~bdavis/math504/vita2016.docx&wdOrigin=BROWSELINK|access-date=2021-10-28|website=view.officeapps.live.com}}</ref>
* James W. Pitman (1994–1996)
* [[S. R. Srinivasa Varadhan|Raghu Varadhan]] (1997–1999)
* [[Thomas G. Kurtz|Thomas Kurtz]] (2000–2002)
* Steven Lalley (2003–2005)
* [[Greg Lawler]] (2006–2008)<ref>{{Cite web|title=Gregory F. Lawler|url=https://www.nasonline.org/directory-entry/gregory-f-lawler-eqgeam/|access-date=2021-10-28|website=nasonline.org}}</ref>
* [[Ofer Zeitouni]] (2009–2011)
* Krzysztof Burdzy (2012–2014)<ref>{{Cite web|title=Krzysztof Burdzy to serve as editor of Annals of Probability {{!}} Department of Mathematics {{!}} University of Washington|url=https://math.washington.edu/news/2011/03/01/krzysztof-burdzy-serve-editor-annals-probability|access-date=2021-10-28|website=math.washington.edu}}</ref>
* [[Maria Eulália Vares]] (2015–2017)
* [[Amir Dembo]] (2018–2020)
* Christophe Garban & [[Alice Guionnet]] (2021–2023)<ref>{{Cite web|title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} Annals of Probability|url=https://imstat.org/journals-and-publications/annals-of-probability/|access-date=2021-10-28|language=en}}</ref>
